additionalRules: Bard's Family may be included in Tauriel's Warband rather than Bard's if you wish.
Lake-town Guard may only be included in the Warbands of Lake-town Hero models.

specialRules.name: The Master's Coin
specialRules.text: At the end of his Activation if he is within 3" of Braga, the Master of Lake-town may spend a Will Point. If he does, Braga immediately regains a Will Point spent earlier in the battle.

specialRules.name: Air of Self-importance
specialRules.text: The Master of Lake-town, Alfrid and Braga may not take part in any Heroic Action declared by Bard or a member of Bard's Family.

specialRules.name: "I Shall Protect You"
specialRules.text: Tauriel may include Kili, Fili, Bofur and Óin in her Warband. Additionally, if Tauriel is within 3" of a friendly Dwarf model who is Engaged in Combat, she gains a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes.

specialRules.name: Stubborn to a Fault
specialRules.text: Friendly Dwarf models may re-roll failed To Wound Rolls either when making a shooting attack or when making Strikes.

specialRules.name: Moneybags
specialRules.text: At the start of the Fight Phase, the Master may spend a Will Point so that Braga, any Lake-town Guard Captains and Lake-town Guard within 6" gain +1 Fight Value and treat him as a banner until end of turn.

specialRules.name: Price of Greed
specialRules.text: At the start of the game the opponent nominates a Hero to carry a sum of gold. If that model contacts the Master, he must take a Courage test or flee and is removed as a casualty.

specialRules.name: Save the Gold!
specialRules.text: Whenever an enemy Hero within 3" is slain, or he holds an Objective at the End Phase, the Master regains a spent Will Point.

specialRules.name: Dubious Counsel
specialRules.text: At the start of his Activation, Alfrid may pick a friendly Lake-town Hero within 6" and roll a D6 (modifiable by spending Will) on a table of minor effects - swapping Might, restoring Will, re-rolls, Fearless, +1 Fight, or restoring Might.

units.name: Bard the Bowman
options: Exchange Great Bow for Armour and Horse - 20 points

specialRules.name: Sworn Protector (Bain, Sigrid, Tilda)
specialRules.text: Passes Courage tests while the named model is alive on the battlefield.

specialRules.name: Rapid Fire
specialRules.text: If Bard hits with his great bow, he may fire again at a model within 3" of the first target (even the same one), chaining up to 3 shots per turn.

specialRules.name: Swift Shot
specialRules.text: Bard never suffers the -1 penalty To Hit for Moving and Shooting.

specialRules.name: The Black Arrow
specialRules.text: If carrying the Windlance, once per game Bard may fire the Black Arrow instead of shooting normally, re-rolling failed To Hit and In The Way rolls, and always striking Dead On against a Battlefield Target.

specialRules.name: Windlance Trained
specialRules.text: Bard may crew the Windlance alone, moving more than 6" from it and rotating it without penalty, and gains +1 to Scatter rolls against Monsters.

units.name: Windlance
wargear: Crewed by two Dale Siege Crew, one of which is the Siege Veteran

specialRules.name: Accurate
specialRules.text: A Windlance will only Scatter 3" rather than 6".

specialRules.name: Piercing Shot
specialRules.text: A model hit by a Windlance shot with Strength 5 or lower is flung back D3" and knocked Prone; models it passes over suffer a Strength 5 hit.

specialRules.name: Mattock
specialRules.text: A two-handed weapon; if the wielder wins the Duel Roll, they may try to knock down a chosen enemy model with an opposed Strength roll instead of making Strikes.

specialRules.name: Steadfast
specialRules.text: Friendly Thorin's Company models within 3" of Bofur may roll a D6 to ignore an enemy special rule or Magical Power effect (3+, before any Resist test).

specialRules.name: The Master's Puppet
specialRules.text: Whilst within 6" and Line of Sight of the Master of Lake-town (who still has Will remaining), Braga automatically passes Courage tests and may re-roll all failed To Wound rolls when Striking.

specialRules.name: Captain of the Guard
specialRules.text: So long as Braga has Will remaining, friendly Lake-town Guard Captains and Lake-town Guard within 3" count as having Dominant (2).

specialRules.name: Combat Synergy
specialRules.text: If Kili and Fili are within 1" of each other, they may swap places for free; if they do, both may re-roll a single D6 in their Duel Roll that Fight Phase.

specialRules.name: Combat Synergy
specialRules.text: If Kili and Fili are within 1" of each other, they may swap places for free; if they do, both may re-roll a single D6 in their Duel Roll that Fight Phase.

specialRules.name: Everyone has a Price
specialRules.text: Whilst within 6" and Line of Sight of the Master of Lake-town (who still has Will remaining), may re-roll failed To Wound rolls of a natural 1 when Striking.

specialRules.name: Healing Herbs
specialRules.text: Once per turn, Óin may pick a friendly Thorin's Company model in base contact and roll a D6; on a 4+, it regains a lost Wound.

specialRules.name: Reading the Portents
specialRules.text: During the Fight Phase, Óin may spend Will Points to let friendly Thorin's Company models within 6" re-roll a single Duel Roll dice each time.

specialRules.name: Hearing Trumpet
specialRules.text: Whenever an enemy Hero declares a Heroic Action within 6", roll a D6; on a 5+, Óin may declare the same Heroic Action for free, but on a natural 1 he loses a Will Point or cannot Move that turn.

specialRules.name: Blade Mistress
specialRules.text: If Outnumbered in a Combat, Tauriel gains an extra Attack for each model beyond the first she is Engaged with, until the Combat ends.

specialRules.name: Vengeful Fury
specialRules.text: If Kíli is in the same army and is slain, Tauriel's Strength becomes 5 and Defence 4 for the rest of the battle, and she must Charge an enemy model whenever possible.

specialRules.name: Bard's Family
specialRules.text: Made up of Bain, Sigrid and Tilda, counting as three models; may only be included alongside Bard the Bowman, as part of his Warband (or Tauriel's per this list's Additional Rules). If a member is slain, Bard must Charge the killer whenever able.

specialRules.name: Family Bond (Bain)
specialRules.text: Whilst within 3" of Sigrid or Tilda, Bain's Attacks increase to 2 and he gains +1 to Courage tests.

specialRules.name: Da! Down here! (Sigrid/Tilda)
specialRules.text: Whilst within 6" of Sigrid or Tilda, Bard gains +1 Fight Value (and a Duel Roll re-roll if within 6" of both); he may also declare a free Heroic Combat to join their fight.

specialRules.name: Fearful
specialRules.text: (Sigrid and Tilda only)

specialRules.name: Everyone has a Price
specialRules.text: Whilst within 6" and Line of Sight of the Master of Lake-town (who still has Will remaining), may re-roll failed To Wound rolls of a natural 1 when Striking.

sourceNotes: Roster, points, and army-wide rules from the prancingponypub Army of Lake-town army-list page. Full stat blocks, wargear, and special-rule text cross-referenced from the Kingdoms of Men, Dwarven Holds, and Elven Kingdoms faction pages on the same site.
